description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Accursed Centaur from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Accursed Centaur enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Earthcraft by tapping Accursed Centaur, untapping the basic Swamp.
Resolve the Accursed Centaur ability, sacrificing it.
Repeat.
